scripts.text: Well, there's nothing more I can teach you for now. Go out into the world and make your mark as a Merchant.

scripts.translation: 啊，你回來繼續學習了。讓我想想要講什麼...對了，金錢攻擊！

scripts.translation: ^871F78金錢攻擊^000000是用澤尼對目標造成大量傷害的技能。金錢就是力量！

scripts.translation: 不過，我給的建議又不要錢。稍微考慮一下我說的話也沒壞處。

scripts.text: Well, if you ever change your mind, stop by and talk to me anytime. And as a Merchant, you should know that free advice is the best!
scripts.translation: 如果你改變主意，隨時可以過來找我。作為商人，你也該知道免費的建議最好！

scripts.text: You know, the name of the company that has all those beautiful ladies working for it. Ka... Ka-something. Anyway, I hear they're concerned about their growing competition.
scripts.translation: 你知道那家公司的名字嗎？有很多漂亮小姐在那裡工作。卡...卡什麼來著。聽說他們很擔心競爭對手越來越多。

scripts.text: It's none of my business, but it's good to know what's going on in
scripts.translation: 這跟我沒關係，不過了解世界上發生的事很有好處，

scripts.text: the world, particularly if it'll affect the markets.
scripts.translation: 尤其是那些會影響市場的訊息。

scripts.text: They're essential for travel, and these Red Potions are the best for newer adventurers~
scripts.translation: 紅色藥水是旅行必備品，這些特別適合剛出發的冒險者~

scripts.text: I will sell you 10 Red Potions for ^871F78{0} zeny^000000. You'd better get them now while they're still here!
scripts.translation: 10瓶紅色藥水只賣^871F78{0}澤尼^000000。趁還有貨，最好現在就買！

scripts.text: You certainly have an eye for bargains. Here you go, 10 Red Potions fresh from the... Potioner...
scripts.translation: 你真會買東西。來，拿好這10瓶剛出爐的...藥劑師特供...

scripts.text: There's no way you carry all of this! Why don't you put some of your stuff in Kafra Storage before coming back?
scripts.translation: 你怎麼可能拿得動這麼多東西！回來之前先把一部分物品存進卡普拉倉庫吧。

scripts.text: has happened to the royal family.
It's probably not even a reliable rumor, but I've heard that members of the royal family have been dying from some unknown cause.
scripts.translation: 這大概只是個不可靠的傳聞，不過我聽說王室成員正因不明原因陸續死亡。

scripts.text: Well, hopefully, there's no truth to it whatsoever. None at all...
scripts.translation: 但願這完全不是真的。真的一點也不是真的...

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but you don't have enough Zeny. I've got to stay in business somehow, you know?
scripts.translation: 很抱歉，你的澤尼不夠。我也得做生意維持生計呀。

scripts.text: You better put some of your stuff in Kafra Storage, you can't carry much else!
scripts.translation: 你最好先把一部分物品存進卡普拉倉庫，身上裝不下更多東西了！

scripts.text: It's true that money isn't everything. I'm sure other things are important to have in order to be happy.
scripts.translation: 錢確實不是一切。要過得幸福，我相信還有其他重要的東西。

scripts.text: However, money can be much more dependable than some people I know. You can rely on money more than anything else in this world.
scripts.translation: 不過，錢比我認識的某些人可靠多了。在這個世界上，你可以依靠錢勝過任何東西。

scripts.text: I'm just a young girl who's a victim of circumstance, forced to sell potions on the street for dirt cheap prices.
scripts.translation: 我只是個命運多舛的年輕女孩，被迫在街邊以低價賣藥水。
只需{0}澤尼，尊敬的冒險者？

scripts.text: I am sorry, but you don't have enough money. Would you please get some more Zeny before coming back?
scripts.translation: 很抱歉，你的錢不夠。可以再準備些澤尼後回來嗎？

scripts.text: You can't possibly carry any more items. Why don't you put your things in Kafra Storage first?
scripts.translation: 你身上裝不下更多物品了。先把東西存進卡普拉倉庫吧。

scripts.text: It's a really interesting country. There's Juno and a few other places worth looking around.
scripts.translation: 真是個有趣的國家。那裡有朱諾，還有幾個值得逛逛的地方。

scripts.text: They may not be the best places
for sight seeing, but I'm sure they'll offer something of interest to you adventurers.
scripts.translation: 不是最好的觀光地，但我相信一定有值得冒險者關注的東西。

scripts.text: If you've checked out the market for Red Potions, you know that my price is the best. I'm offering 10 Red Potions for only {0} Zeny!
scripts.translation: 如果你調查過紅色藥水的行情，就會知道我的價格最低。10瓶只要{0}澤尼！

scripts.text: But sorry buddy. I can't let you carry more than you can handle.
scripts.translation: 不過抱歉啦，夥計。我不能讓你帶走超出負重的東西。

scripts.text: You ought to free up some of your inventory space when you get the chance.
scripts.translation: 有空時最好清理一下背包。

scripts.text: I see too many people struggling to scrape every penny and put it all into their savings...
scripts.translation: 我看到太多人省吃儉用，把每一分錢都存起來...

scripts.text: Now, don't get me wrong. It's a good idea to invest in the future. But money exists to be spent! Enjoy every moment, that's what I say~
scripts.translation: 別誤會，投資未來當然是好事。不過錢就是用來花的！我覺得應該享受每一刻~

scripts.text: for the low price of {0} Zeny~
Good products at affordable prices! That's my ethic as a merchant.
scripts.translation: 優質商品，價格實惠！這是我做生意的原則。

scripts.text: Ooh, but you don't even have enough Zeny to purchase these potions. I'm sorry, but I can't sell these just to lose money, you know?
scripts.translation: 噢，不過你的澤尼不夠買這些藥水。抱歉，我總不能虧本賣給你吧。

scripts.text: Ooh, but it doesn't look like you've got enough inventory space to carry any more items.
scripts.translation: 噢，不過看起來你的背包空間也不夠，裝不下更多東西了。

scripts.text: Well, I can't force you to buy these, but I'm telling you that you're passing up a real bargain!
scripts.translation: 我不會勉強你買，不過你可錯過了一筆好買賣！
